basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech aficionado based in San Francisco with a deep interest in blockchain technology and cryptocurrencies. My journey in tech started over a decade ago when I was captivated by the potential of decentralized systems. Aside from my professional life as a software engineer, I enjoy exploring different fandoms, from Star Wars to niche gaming communities like Knights of the Old Republic. In my free time, I often find myself binge-watching Judge Judy and engaging with the BABYDOGEARMY community. I usually contribute to Reddit during evenings and weekends. I'm happily married, and my spouse shares my interest in technology.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have worked in the software industry for over a decade, primarily focusing on blockchain technologies. My knowledge extends beyond academic learning; I spend a lot of time on forums and online courses to stay updated on the latest developments in the tech world.
